request.prompt:
You are structuring records from a private professional network so they can be
matched against each other.

For each person below, classify them from the fields provided and nothing else.

RULES
- Use only the values listed in the schema. Never invent a category.
- `unknown` is a correct answer whenever the record does not say. A record with
  no bio, no title and no company supports almost nothing: return unknown rather
  than a guess. Returning unknown is never penalised. Guessing is.
- `needs` and `offers`: short phrases, at most five each, describing what this
  person is looking for and what they can provide. If the record already lists
  them, tidy them; if it does not, infer them ONLY from the bio, and leave the
  list empty when the bio does not support any.
- `evidence`: for each classification you are confident about, cite the field
  you used and copy the exact span of text from it. The quote must appear
  verbatim in that field -- it is checked automatically. Do not paraphrase, do
  not quote a field that is empty, and do not cite a field you did not use.
- `confidence`: your confidence in the whole record, 0.0 to 1.0. A record that
  is mostly unknown should score low.

Respond with JSON only, in this shape:
{
  "$defs": {
    "Evidence": {
      "properties": {
        "field": {
          "enum": [
            "full_name",
            "email",
            "linkedin_url",
            "company",
            "title",
            "location",
            "bio",
            "needs",
            "offers"
          ],
          "title": "Field",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "quote": {
          "description": "text copied verbatim from that field",
          "title": "Quote",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "supports": {
          "description": "which enrichment field this justifies",
          "title": "Supports",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "field",
        "quote",
        "supports"
      ],
      "title": "Evidence",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "PersonEnrichment": {
      "properties": {
        "person_id": {
          "title": "Person Id",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "persona": {
          "enum": [
            "founder",
            "operator",
            "investor",
            "service_provider",
            "ic",
            "unknown"
          ],
          "title": "Persona",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "seniority": {
          "enum": [
            "founder",
            "c_level",
            "vp",
            "director",
            "head_or_lead",
            "senior_ic",
            "mid",
            "junior",
            "unknown"
          ],
          "title": "Seniority",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "company_stage": {
          "enum": [
            "pre_seed",
            "seed",
            "series_a",
            "series_b",
            "growth",
            "public",
            "not_applicable",
            "unknown"
          ],
          "title": "Company Stage",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "sector": {
          "enum": [
            "b2b_saas",
            "fintech",
            "healthtech",
            "climate",
            "devtools",
            "ecommerce",
            "marketplace",
            "ai_infra",
            "cybersecurity",
            "logistics",
            "edtech",
            "consumer",
            "investing",
            "services",
            "other",
            "unknown"
          ],
          "title": "Sector",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "geography": {
          "enum": [
            "india",
            "south_east_asia",
            "middle_east",
            "europe",
            "north_america",
            "latin_america",
            "africa",
            "apac",
            "unknown"
          ],
          "title": "Geography",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "needs": {
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "maxItems": 5,
          "title": "Needs",
          "type": "array"
        },
        "offers": {
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "maxItems": 5,
          "title": "Offers",
          "type": "array"
        },
        "confidence": {
          "maximum": 1.0,
          "minimum": 0.0,
          "title": "Confidence",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "evidence": {
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"
          },
          "maxItems": 8,
          "title": "Evidence",
          "type": "array"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "person_id",
        "persona",
        "seniority",
        "company_stage",
        "sector",
        "geography",
        "confidence"
      ],
      "title": "PersonEnrichment",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "properties": {
    "people": {
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/PersonEnrichment"
      },
      "title": "People",
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "people"
  ],
  "title": "EnrichmentBatch",
  "type": "object"
}
